# TDS Document Scout

Twelve free browser tools across AI, images, JSON data, time zones, file delivery and PDF. Three real local AI tools: portrait background removal with MODNet, English audio transcription with Whisper Tiny English, and extractive English summaries using MiniLM sentence embeddings. AI models download from Hugging Face and jsDelivr on explicit load; first-run download, network and memory requirements apply. Inputs remain on the device. AI results require review and are not factual guarantees. Includes image resizing and conversion, lossless-number JSON validation and comparison, and an international meeting planner with local calendar export. Files stay on your device. Separate open-source and video sections link six external projects and three credited English YouTube tutorials to practical workflows. These are not TDS-hosted applications. Licenses and limitations are listed per project. Videos connect to YouTube only after the user loads the player. Optional equipment affiliate links do not unlock AI features. Resource index: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/resource-library.json. The /document-tools page is a task directory; each tool has its own stable URL. Automated signals do not certify WCAG or PDF/UA conformance. No OCR or tag repair.

- [Open-source tools](https://thedollscout.com/open-source) (en): Find the right open-source tool for a real task. Compare setup, limits and the next step before installing.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source.txt
- [Upscayl: Enlarge a small image with local AI.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/upscayl) (en): Use it when you need a larger raster image, then compare the result at full size. Desktop processing needs a compatible Vulkan-capable GPU; a CPU alone is not the normal supported path. Upscayl Cloud is separate.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/upscayl.txt
- [Whisper: Transcribe longer or multilingual audio locally.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/whisper) (en): Choose the Python project for its model choices and language coverage. Setup needs Python, FFmpeg and enough resources for the selected model. For a short English clip, the TDS browser tool has a smaller setup.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/whisper.txt
- [Ollama: Run a selected language model on your own computer.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/ollama) (en): Useful when you want a local model workflow and can manage model downloads and memory use. Select a local model and check the current documentation; hosted/cloud features have separate behavior.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/ollama.txt
- [OBS Studio: Record a screen demonstration.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/obs) (en): OBS Studio fits screen recording, scenes and audio sources. Start with its auto-configuration wizard and make a short recording on your actual computer. No streaming account is needed just to record.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/obs.txt
- [Audacity: Record and edit speech before transcription.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/audacity) (en): Audacity is a desktop audio editor for recording, trimming and mixing. It is useful for preparing a short speech clip and listening closely to mistakes.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/audacity.txt
- [Shotcut: Edit a screen recording into a short tutorial.](https://thedollscout.com/open-source/shotcut) (en): Shotcut provides a desktop timeline for cutting clips, adding titles and exporting video. The selected introductory video is linked by Shotcut’s official tutorial page.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/open-source/shotcut.txt
- [Video tutorials](https://thedollscout.com/videos) (en): Short introductions to image, audio and video tools, with creator credits and a practical task you can finish afterwards.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/videos.txt
- [Upscayl: your first AI image upscale](https://thedollscout.com/videos/upscayl) (en): Make one enlarged image, inspect the result, then prepare a smaller web export.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/videos/upscayl.txt
- [Audacity: record, edit and prepare speech](https://thedollscout.com/videos/audacity) (en): Record a clear short clip and prepare it for an English transcript.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/videos/audacity.txt
- [Shotcut: a first edit and export](https://thedollscout.com/videos/shotcut) (en): Turn one raw recording into a short edited tutorial and prepare its thumbnail.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/videos/shotcut.txt
- [Creator setup](https://thedollscout.com/creator-kit) (en): Start with the computer and equipment you already own. Upgrade only when a recording or editing test reveals a specific problem.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/creator-kit.txt
- [AI portrait background remover](https://thedollscout.com/ai-portrait-background-remover) (en): Remove the background from a portrait with an AI model in your browser. Download a transparent PNG without uploading the photo.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/ai-portrait-background-remover.txt
- [AI audio to text — English](https://thedollscout.com/ai-audio-to-text) (en): Transcribe a short English WAV or MP3 locally with Whisper. Download a text draft and approximate SRT subtitles without uploading the recording.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/ai-audio-to-text.txt
- [AI extractive text summarizer](https://thedollscout.com/ai-text-summarizer) (en): Find key sentences in English text with a local AI model. Keep the original wording, trace each selection to its source and download the highlights.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/ai-text-summarizer.txt
- [Image compressor & converter](https://thedollscout.com/image-compressor) (en): Resize images and export JPEG, PNG or WebP. Compare actual dimensions and file sizes before downloading each result.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/image-compressor.txt
- [JSON validator, formatter & comparison](https://thedollscout.com/json-compare) (en): Validate JSON, format it without rounding large numbers, and compare two versions by field path. Export formatted JSON or a change report.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/json-compare.txt
- [Time zone meeting planner](https://thedollscout.com/time-zone-planner) (en): Compare a meeting in several cities, catch daylight-saving clock changes, and download a calendar file with one unambiguous UTC start and end.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/time-zone-planner.txt
- [Check the file you received](https://thedollscout.com/verify-file) (en): Is this the same file your sender intended? Compare it with their verification link, locally in your browser.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/verify-file.txt
- [Build a client delivery record](https://thedollscout.com/delivery-evidence) (en): Keep the exact files, agreed scope and client response together. Create a portable handoff record in your browser.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/delivery-evidence.txt
- [Free image, PDF & file tools for everyday work](https://thedollscout.com/document-tools) (en): For creators and small teams: prepare images for publishing, check document changes and keep a clear record of the files you hand over. Free, in your browser, without an account.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/home.txt
- [PDF accessibility checker](https://thedollscout.com/pdf-accessibility-checker) (en): Inspect titles, language declarations, tags and extractable text. See page-level issues and the checks that still need a person.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/pdf-accessibility-checker.txt
- [Batch PDF audit](https://thedollscout.com/pdf-batch-audit) (en): Review up to 10 PDFs together. Prioritize document issues, record manual checks, and export one CSV or JSON handover.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/pdf-batch-audit.txt
- [PDF to text](https://thedollscout.com/pdf-to-text) (en): Extract text from a readable PDF with page boundaries. Identify pages with no extractable text before choosing an OCR workflow.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/pdf-to-text.txt
- [Compare PDF text](https://thedollscout.com/compare-pdf-text) (en): Compare the extracted text of two PDF versions. Find changed, added and removed pages, with unchanged pages aligned after insertions.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/compare-pdf-text.txt
- [PDF accessibility checklist before you publish](https://thedollscout.com/learn/pdf-accessibility-checklist) (en): Start with the source document. Use real heading styles, meaningful link text, suitable table headers and text alternatives before exporting a tagged PDF.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/learn/pdf-accessibility-checklist.txt
- [Scanned PDF or text PDF: choose the right next step](https://thedollscout.com/learn/scanned-pdf-vs-text-pdf) (en): A PDF can contain actual text, page images or both. Being able to see words does not mean those words are extractable or usable with assistive technology.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/learn/scanned-pdf-vs-text-pdf.txt
- [How to review PDF reading order](https://thedollscout.com/learn/pdf-reading-order) (en): Text extraction order is not proof of screen-reader reading order. PDF structure tags, text content order and the viewer can affect the reading experience.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/learn/pdf-reading-order.txt
- [How checks work](https://thedollscout.com/methodology) (en): The reader parses actual PDF objects with Mozilla PDF.js. It inspects title and language metadata, the tagged-document declaration, page text, exposed structure roles and interactive fields.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/methodology.txt
- [File privacy](https://thedollscout.com/document-privacy) (en): Selected PDFs, filenames, titles, extracted text, comparisons and manual review notes stay in browser memory. They are not uploaded to our servers. Clear the workspace or close the tab to discard them.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/document-privacy.txt
- [Collector guides](https://thedollscout.com/collectors) (en): Explore collectible toys, buying guides and collection tools. Start with the brand guides on the TDS homepage.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/en/collectors.txt
- [Open Source](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source) (de): Open-Source-Software für konkrete Aufgaben. Einrichtung, Grenzen und den nächsten Schritt vor der Installation vergleichen.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source.txt
- [Upscayl: Ein kleines Bild mit lokaler KI vergrößern.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/upscayl) (de): Für größere Rasterbilder mit anschließender Sichtprüfung. Desktop-Verarbeitung erfordert eine kompatible Vulkan-GPU; reine CPU-Verarbeitung ist kein regulärer unterstützter Weg. Upscayl Cloud ist separat.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/upscayl.txt
- [Whisper: Längere oder mehrsprachige Audiodateien lokal transkribieren.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/whisper) (de): Das Python-Projekt bietet verschiedene Modelle und Sprachen. Python, FFmpeg und passende Hardware sind nötig. Für einen kurzen englischen Clip ist das TDS-Browserwerkzeug einfacher.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/whisper.txt
- [Ollama: Ein gewähltes Sprachmodell auf dem eigenen Rechner ausführen.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/ollama) (de): Für lokale Modellabläufe mit eigener Verwaltung von Downloads und Speicher. Ein lokales Modell wählen und aktuelle Dokumentation lesen; Cloud-Funktionen verhalten sich anders.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/ollama.txt
- [OBS Studio: Eine Bildschirmvorführung aufzeichnen.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/obs) (de): OBS Studio bietet Bildschirmaufnahme, Szenen und Audioquellen. Mit dem Assistenten und einer kurzen Aufnahme auf dem eigenen Rechner beginnen. Für lokale Aufnahmen ist kein Streaming-Konto nötig.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/obs.txt
- [Audacity: Sprache vor der Transkription aufnehmen und schneiden.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/audacity) (de): Desktop-Audioeditor zum Aufnehmen, Kürzen und Mischen. Gut zum Vorbereiten eines kurzen Sprachclips und zum genauen Abhören.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/audacity.txt
- [Shotcut: Eine Aufnahme zu einem kurzen Tutorial schneiden.](https://thedollscout.com/de/open-source/shotcut) (de): Desktop-Zeitleiste für Schnitt, Titel und Videoexport. Das ausgewählte Einführungsvideo wird auf der offiziellen Tutorial-Seite verlinkt.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/open-source/shotcut.txt
- [Video-Anleitungen](https://thedollscout.com/de/videos) (de): Einführungen in Bild-, Audio- und Videowerkzeuge mit Urheberangaben und einer praktischen Folgeaufgabe.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/videos.txt

- [Creator-Ausrüstung](https://thedollscout.com/de/creator-kit) (de): Zuerst mit dem vorhandenen Computer und Zubehör arbeiten. Nur aufrüsten, wenn ein konkretes Problem bei einer Testaufnahme sichtbar wird.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/creator-kit.txt
- [KI-Hintergrundentfernung für Porträts](https://thedollscout.com/de/ai-portrait-background-remover) (de): Den Hintergrund eines Porträts mit KI im Browser entfernen. Ein transparentes PNG herunterladen, ohne das Foto hochzuladen.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/ai-portrait-background-remover.txt
- [KI-Audio in Text — Englisch](https://thedollscout.com/de/ai-audio-to-text) (de): Kurze englische WAV- oder MP3-Aufnahmen lokal mit Whisper transkribieren. Text und ungefähre SRT-Untertitel ohne Audio-Upload herunterladen.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/ai-audio-to-text.txt
- [KI-Textzusammenfassung mit Original-Sätzen](https://thedollscout.com/de/ai-text-summarizer) (de): Wichtige Sätze in englischem Text mit lokaler KI finden. Wortlaut erhalten, Auswahl zur Quelle zurückverfolgen und herunterladen.

- [PDF-Barrierefreiheit prüfen](https://thedollscout.com/de/pdf-accessibility-checker) (de): Titel, Sprachangaben, Tags und auslesbaren Text prüfen. Auffällige Seiten und notwendige manuelle Prüfungen erkennen.

- [PDF-Stapelprüfung](https://thedollscout.com/de/pdf-batch-audit) (de): Bis zu 10 PDFs gemeinsam prüfen. Auffälligkeiten priorisieren, manuelle Prüfungen festhalten und als CSV oder JSON exportieren.

- [PDF in Text umwandeln](https://thedollscout.com/de/pdf-to-text) (de): Vorhandenen PDF-Text mit Seitengrenzen auslesen. Seiten ohne auslesbaren Text erkennen, bevor Sie einen OCR-Ablauf wählen.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/pdf-to-text.txt
- [PDF-Texte vergleichen](https://thedollscout.com/de/compare-pdf-text) (de): Den ausgelesenen Text zweier PDF-Versionen vergleichen. Geänderte, neue und entfernte Seiten finden; unveränderte Seiten werden zugeordnet.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/compare-pdf-text.txt

- [Scan oder Text-PDF: den nächsten Schritt wählen](https://thedollscout.com/de/learn/scanned-pdf-vs-text-pdf) (de): PDFs können Text, Seitenbilder oder beides enthalten. Sichtbare Wörter sind nicht immer auslesbarer Text.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/learn/scanned-pdf-vs-text-pdf.txt
- [Die PDF-Lesereihenfolge prüfen](https://thedollscout.com/de/learn/pdf-reading-order) (de): Die Reihenfolge ausgelesenen Texts beweist nicht die Screenreader-Reihenfolge. Tags, Inhalte und PDF-Viewer beeinflussen das Ergebnis.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/learn/pdf-reading-order.txt
- [Prüfmethode](https://thedollscout.com/de/methodology) (de): Mozilla PDF.js liest die tatsächlichen PDF-Objekte. Geprüft werden Titel, Sprachangaben, Tag-Deklaration, Seitentext, sichtbare Strukturrollen und Formularfelder.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/methodology.txt
- [Dateidatenschutz](https://thedollscout.com/de/document-privacy) (de): PDFs, Dateinamen, Titel, Text, Vergleiche und Prüfnotizen bleiben im Browserspeicher. Es erfolgt kein Upload. Arbeitsbereich leeren oder Tab schließen, um sie zu verwerfen.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/document-privacy.txt
- [Sammlerratgeber](https://thedollscout.com/de/collectors) (de): Sammelfiguren, Kaufratgeber und Sammlungswerkzeuge. Die Markenratgeber finden Sie auf der TDS-Startseite.
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/de/collectors.txt
- [开源工具](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source) (zh): 按具体任务选择开源工具。先看安装要求、适用范围和下一步，再决定是否下载。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source.txt
- [Upscayl: 用本地 AI 放大小图片。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/upscayl) (zh): 适合需要更大尺寸并愿意逐项检查结果的图片任务。桌面版需要兼容 Vulkan 的 GPU，只有 CPU 不是常规支持方式；Upscayl Cloud 为独立服务。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/upscayl.txt
- [Whisper: 在本地转录较长或多语言音频。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/whisper) (zh): Python 项目适合需要更多模型与语言选择的人。安装需 Python、FFmpeg 以及适配所选模型的硬件资源；短英文片段可以先用 TDS 浏览器工具。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/whisper.txt
- [Ollama: 在自己的电脑上运行选定的语言模型。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/ollama) (zh): 适合愿意管理模型下载与内存用量的本地 AI 工作流。选择本地模型并参考当前文档；云模型等功能有不同的数据处理方式。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/ollama.txt
- [OBS Studio: 录制屏幕操作演示。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/obs) (zh): OBS Studio 可配置屏幕录制、场景和音频来源。先运行自动配置向导，再在自己的设备上试录；仅本地录制不需要直播账号。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/obs.txt
- [Audacity: 录制并整理适合转录的人声。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/audacity) (zh): 桌面音频编辑器，可录音、裁剪与混音。适合制作一小段语音素材，并仔细试听错误。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/audacity.txt
- [Shotcut: 把录屏剪成一段工具演示。](https://thedollscout.com/zh/open-source/shotcut) (zh): 桌面时间线适合裁剪、加标题与导出视频。所选入门视频来自 Shotcut 官方教程页的推荐链接。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/open-source/shotcut.txt
- [视频教程](https://thedollscout.com/zh/videos) (zh): 精选图片、音频与视频工具的 YouTube 入门介绍，保留作者署名，并配上看完就能做的练习。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/videos.txt
- [Upscayl：第一次用 AI 放大图片](https://thedollscout.com/zh/videos/upscayl) (zh): 放大一张图片，检查细节，再准备更小的网页导出版本。
  Plain text: https://thedollscout.com/document-assets/text/zh/videos/upscayl.txt
- [Audacity：录制、剪辑与准备人声](https://thedollscout.com/zh/videos/audacity) (zh): 录制清楚的短片段，准备进行英文音频转文字。
